said.no-log: The run log cannot be written: {reason}
said.notice/disconnected: NapCat disconnected; waiting for it to reconnect.
said.notice/disconnected-as: NapCat disconnected ({bot}); waiting for it to reconnect.
said.failure/core-gone: The core went away; the QQ bridge stops.
said.failure/port-in-use: Port {port} is in use. Pick another: miyu config set --system onebot.listen <port>, and change NapCat to match.
said.failure/crashed: The QQ bridge hit a bug and stops: {reason}
said.failure/start: The QQ bridge could not start: {reason}
said.unready/no-token: The QQ bridge token (onebot.token) is not set. Save one with miyu login onebot, then put it in the system config: miyu config set --system onebot.token '{{ secret = "onebot" }}'. Give NapCat the same token.
said.unready/bad-port: onebot.listen could not be read; check it with miyu config check --system.
